title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #129 · 교복 · 오프숄더 체크 × 치어리더 플레어 초미니 · 플랫 페니 로퍼+네이비 니삭스 · black glamour · 3/4 각도·팔 위로 · 배경 얼음 동굴 · 오네에갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 20s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long wavy balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped long-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with the collar and neckline slipped low off both shoulders so that her shoulders and collarbones are bare, a loose red ribbon tie hanging at her chest, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro flared cheerleader skirt of red tartan plaid modal jersey with a white trim along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones and flaring outward with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones, the matching micro briefs of the same fabric peeking beneath the hem. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the shirt slipping off her shoulders, the loose red ribbon and the flared cheerleader skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme black glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: glossy black leather penny loafers with a small gold coin detail, worn with navy knee-high socks with a thin white stripe at the top, her feet planted flat on the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a bright blue-white glacier ice cave lit by daylight through the ice, a flat frozen floor and a standard-height wooden walkway rail, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
